intro_text: This scenario presents a decision about how to allocate public safety resources in a generic city. You will evaluate four distinct strategies for addressing public safety needs, each representing a different approach: building new infrastructure, expanding existing facilities, increasing patrol presence, or investing in community-based prevention. Your stakeholder group brings a particular perspective to this complex decision involving trade-offs between cost, effectiveness, implementation speed, and community impact.
voting_instructions: Use the five-level scale to rate criterion importance. You are not ranking schools directly; you are expressing which evaluation criteria matter most.
